text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is staring into a snack packet with a torn look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Urk… Just one wouldn't hurt, right? But then again, I don't want any breakouts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well, I told Creek about how my skin's been acting up, and she said I should cut down on all the greasy food.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But it's so hard to resist when the snacks are right there in front of me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Sigh… No more carrot snacks for me. I guess I'll stick to spinach cookies instead…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not willing to risk a breakout, Oguri Cap seems somewhat disheartened now that she can't enjoy her favorite foods.
